exposure: nucleated red blood cell (NRBC) counts at birth
cohort: The study included 143 preterm neonates (birth weight <1500 g and/or gestational age <32 weeks) born at Ghaem Hospital, Mashhad, between 2017 and 2020.
finding: Elevated umbilical cord NRBC counts, alongside other clinical markers, may serve as a predictive factor for ROP and its severity, with significant differences observed in NRBC percentage and fifth-minute Apgar score between groups.
followup_time: Ophthalmologic evaluation for ROP was performed at 32 weeks of gestational age or four weeks post-birth, with follow-up continuing until discharge.
